summary: Implemented App.call_from_thread in src/textual/app.py, with thread-entry state (_loop, _thread_id) initialized in __init__ and set/cleared in run()'s run_app coroutine via try/finally. Added tests/test_concurrency.py with 10 tests; all pass when run with PYTHONPATH pointing at the repo's src (the shared venv's textual is an editable install of a different checkout). Full suite excluding snapshot, devtools, and cli tests: 68 failed, 615 passed; the failures I inspected come from the environment (async tests without pytest-asyncio, missing aiohttp), but I did not verify them against a clean checkout. Nothing committed.
